Markus — thanks for pulling this together and for the clear guardrails.

Summary of procurement stance after review:
- Policy background: our standard onboarding requires a PO for engagements > $0
  (preferred) but we do maintain an "invoice-only" provisional route for small,
  time-boxed pilots under $10k with explicit approvals.
- Approvals: I can approve a provisional invoice-only path for up to 30 days
  (starting with the invoice date) provided the following conditions are met BEFORE
  work begins:
    1) Kestrel provides completed vendor onboarding form (received) and W-9 or
       equivalent tax documentation (required).
    2) Kestrel completes our security intake questionnaire (SOC2 or evidence of
       controls). If SOC2 is not available, vendor must provide compensating
       controls and agree to start with limited data scope (no PII, token retention
       capped).
    3) Commercial terms limited to the SOW (no automatic renewals or add-ons).
    4) AP will place the engagement on hold for escalation if invoice remains
       unpaid after Net 30.

If the above are satisfied I authorize a single, one-time invoice-only acceptance
for the SOW amount capped at $9,800. This approval is narrowly scoped and expires
automatically after 30 days — Procurement will not accept repeated invoice-only
arrangements without a PO exception process.

by end of day tomorrow so Procurement can finalize.
